name: Purge wild cotton remains active with zero loaded farm plots

steps._note: Use a disposable Purge world with Advanced Farming on and zero loaded REBIRTH farm plots. Confirm the actual no-plot fixture and use a mature wild Cotton with a one-unit native pickup prompt. Leave the cursor empty, reserve inventory room and aim at the plant. Repeat on a second plant while the first cotton is still in the backpack. Run solo and dedicated. Separate add/remove-plot and native water exchange controls use actual live fixtures.
